title: The terminal panel works with a keyboard and a screen reader

checks.label: the panel is open on the held step
dark: axe (WCAG 2.0/2.1 A+AA) finds nothing in the panel
light: axe (WCAG 2.0/2.1 A+AA) finds nothing in the panel
every control has an accessible name
the terminal is a named region, described by how to leave it

observed.label: Terminal for design
observed.keys: F6 moves between the terminal and the buttons above it; the terminal keeps Tab and Esc for itself.

checks.label: Screen reader mode is a toggle that turns on xterm's accessibility tree
Tab in the terminal stays in the terminal (the program gets it)
F6 moves focus out of the terminal to the panel's buttons
and that button shows its focus ring
Tab cycles inside the panel (it is a modal dialog)
F6 again goes back into the terminal
Escape in the terminal leaves the panel open
and focus in the terminal
the program received the Escape (its line reads "^[escprobe")
Continue is pending: Continue and Release are disabled
F6 leaves the terminal for an enabled control while Continue is pending
with every control disabled, F6 moves focus to the panel itself
Escape on the panel's buttons closes the panel (after dismissing the button's tooltip)
proof (API): the step is still HELD after closing
its card offers Open terminal
